result.title: Defence Rebuttal
result.content: The Crown's submission correctly notes both E-001 and E-002 are attributed, disputed accounts. Mira describes a handover; Tavi describes Fictional Rowan departing with the blue token still in hand and states no handover was seen — that does not deny an unseen event. Two attributed accounts, inconsistent on whether a handover occurred, cannot jointly establish receipt beyond a reasonable doubt when neither is independently corroborated. The Defence rests on the supplied record.
